items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: Maggie Hargraves was one of the finest of all show piano players and blues piano players alive... Well I played with Bessie

ctx.x: But when they didn't have a piano player, why we had to play. Maggie Hargraves was one of the finest of all show piano players and blues piano players alive
at that time. She could play with anyone. Well I played with Bessie -- the year I don't remember. It couldn't of been in '25. I could've been somewhere around '25. Late '25.
